title: Cadmies Knowledge System
definition: A three-layered knowledge system comprising a conceptual fortress (Cosmium Angelo), a volcanic glass library (Scientific Obsidian), and a living knowledge network (CADMIES Mycelium).

difficulty_levels.beginner: CADMIES is a library system with three parts: a fortress (Cosmium Angelo), a frozen record (Scientific Obsidian), and a living network (CADMIES Mycelium).
difficulty_levels.intermediate: CADMIES is a knowledge system consisting of a container (Cosmium Angelo), a record (Scientific Obsidian), and a life (CADMIES Mycelium). The system operates through a zettelkasten methodology, with each phase documented in the Scientific Obsidian vault.
difficulty_levels.expert: CADMIES is a novel blend of physical and conceptual elements, symbolizing the fusion of technology and knowledge. It is a system of three layers: the fortress (Cosmium Angelo), the record (Scientific Obsidian), and the life (CADMIES Mycelium). The integration of these elements creates a robust, adaptable, and eternally evolving knowledge system. The use of zettelkasten methodology enhances the interconnectedness and accessibility of knowledge, while the three-layer system ensures a balance between stability and dynamism.

extra_fields.insight: The integration of physical and conceptual elements in a knowledge management system creates a unique blend of stability and dynamism.
